name: ClawShell
description: Pluggable exoskeleton enhancement layer for OpenClaw-class AI agent frameworks — 4-layer architecture with multi-agent cluster

cloud_hub.name: 云枢
cloud_hub.description: Cloud Hub — 6 core engines: EventBus, TaskBoard, CapabilityRegistry, AgentMesh, InsightEngine, HermesLoop

components.eventbus: CloudEventBus — 持久化+去重+广播+过期
components.task_board: GlobalTaskBoard — 跨设备共享任务看板
components.capability_registry: CapabilityRegistry — Agent注册+能力声明+调度
components.agent_mesh: AgentMesh — Agent级能力匹配+跨设备任务调度
components.insight_engine: InsightEngine — 会话洞察聚合+模式挖掘
components.auth: 用户认证+审批流程+GitHub repo自动创建

local_brain.name: ClawShell Local
local_brain.description: Local brain — 环境检测/适配器管理/Agent发现/5-way注入/三通道同步

components.compiler: L1~L4四层编译器 + Genome知识传承 (从exoskeleton移入)
components.adapters: 3类型统一适配器 (framework/bridge/ide) — 统一BaseAdapter接口
components.agent: AgentScanner自动发现 + AgentInjector五路注入 + AgentProfileStore
components.sync_daemon: 三通道SyncDaemon — GitHub (知识/技能) + MemOS Cloud (记忆) + Cloud Hub (任务/凭证)

exoskeleton.name: 外骨骼层
exoskeleton.description: 四层智能增强 — 自感知/自适应/自组织/多Agent集群 (已整合入local/compiler/)

philosophy: 工程控制论 — 信息反馈、动态调控、系统整体思维
